name: yaps-srt-generator
description: Generate an SRT subtitle file from audio or video with Yaps.

interface.shortDescription: Generate SRT subtitles from audio or video.
interface.longDescription: Create a timestamped .srt subtitle file from an existing audio or video file using the local Whisper component supplied by Yaps desktop. The plugin checks app, sign-in, model, and FFmpeg readiness, preserves existing outputs, and reports the exact file Yaps generated.
defaultPrompt: Generate an SRT file from this video.
Create timed subtitles for this audio file.
Set up local SRT generation with Yaps.
